company_name: Avino Silver & Gold Mines Ltd. Common Shares (Canada)
title: GBR LATAM North and Caribbean Mining 2026 Report
body_markdown:
‍


‍


##### *" For 2026, we allocated 30,000 m of drilling, split evenly between La Preciosa and our Avino mine. We are drilling below the mine’s lowest developed level, which has never been explored at depth."*


‍


**Could you provide an update on the La Preciosa project?**


**‍**
We began developing La Preciosa in April 2025 with the construction of a 350 m de-cline. Mining initially focused on two veins, Gloria and Abundancia. By Q4 2025, we reached ore-grade material, which we transported to our processing plant at Avi-no. Both veins are wider than anticipated, prompting a shift from small-scale shrink-age stoping to long-hole mining. We began verifying historic drill data and re-drilled some holes. The results revealed grades higher than the 200 g/t AgEq previously reported, and confirmed underground mining will yield higher-grade material.


‍
